test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A pipe can fill a tank in 30 hours. Due to a leakage at the bottom, it is filled in 50 hours. How much time will the leakage take to empty the completely filled tank?
solution:
Given

A pipe can fill a tank in 30 hours.

Due to leakage at the bottom, it is filled in 50 hours.

Formula used:

Total work = man × efficiency

Calculation

Tank filled without leakage = 1/30

Tank filled with leakage = 1/50

Pipe empty the completely filled tank in one hour = 1/30 – 1/50

= (5 - 3)/150

= 1/75

**75 hours is the time taken to empty the completely filled tank.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__time taken to empty the completely filled tank = [(50) × 30] /(50 - 30)

= (1500)/(20)

= 75 hours
